title: subtube device file, version 1
description: One device's channel filters, watched marks and settings, kept as device-<deviceId>.json in the user's Google Drive app folder (<deviceId> matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$). Each device writes only its own file and reads every device's file. This schema says what a writer must write. Readers are more forgiving (shared/fixtures/merge.json) and must keep fields they don't know: an object read from a file and written back, or a filter edited and saved, keeps every unknown field unchanged, so a newer client's additions survive an older client's saves. Adding an optional field keeps version 1; any change an older reader would misread bumps `version`, and a reader skips files whose version it doesn't know.

version.description: Format version. Readers skip a file whose version they don't know.

channels.description: The last filter this device saved for each channel, keyed by YouTube channel id (UC…).

watched.description: The last watched mark this device made for each video or playlist, keyed by its YouTube id, with how far a video has been played. An entry is dropped when the device writes once both its `at` and its `seen` are 30 days old or more (shared/fixtures/prune.json).

settings.description: The last value this device saved for each synced setting, keyed by setting name. Optional: a file without it has saved no setting. Names and values this schema doesn't list are allowed and kept; shared/fixtures/settings.json says how the known ones are read: feedSort (newest, shortest, title, random), channelSort (newest, name, unwatched), autoplay (boolean), timeChip (none, day, week, month), topicChips (array of YouTube video category ids, as strings), channelTimeChip (as timeChip), channelTopicChips (as topicChips), groupChips and channelGroupChips (arrays of group names, shared/fixtures/groups.json).

at.description: When the entry was saved, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).
When the entry was saved, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

watched.description: true: the item is watched whatever else the entry holds — a mark made without playing (setup's starting point), a playlist whose last video ended, or a video whose player reported the end. false: an explicit unmark, or a video being played, which is then watched or not by its `position` (shared/fixtures/watch-progress.json).

position.description: How far the video has been played, in seconds from its start; may be fractional. Optional: an entry without it has no position, and a playlist never has one. A reader works out from it and the video's length whether the video is watched, where it resumes and how full its progress bar is (shared/fixtures/watch-progress.json).

seen.description: When this device last had the item among the items of a full load, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC). Optional: an entry without it has not been in a load since it was saved. Set after a load, at most once a day per entry, without changing `at`; it takes no part in merging, where `at` alone orders entries (shared/fixtures/merge.json). It keeps the entry from being dropped (shared/fixtures/prune.json).

at.description: When the entry was saved, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

value.description: The setting's value: any JSON value. A reader that doesn't recognize it uses the setting's default and still keeps the entry.

filter.description: A channel's filter (shared/fixtures/filters.json). The channel's identity (id, title, thumbnail) belongs to YouTube and is never stored here. A reader treats a missing field, or one holding a value it doesn't recognize, as the field's default.

enabled.description: Whether the main feed loads this channel. Default true.

regex.description: Filter pattern in the shared pattern language (shared/patterns/README.md); "" means no pattern. Default "". The pattern below is shared/patterns/meta-regex.txt.

mode.description: include keeps items the pattern finds; exclude drops them. Default include.

caseSensitive.description: Whether the pattern matches ASCII letters case-sensitively. Default false.

searchScope.description: What the pattern is searched in; both searches title and description separately. Default title.

minDurationSeconds.description: Drop videos shorter than this many seconds; 0 keeps every length. Default 0.

liveFilter.description: Which broadcast kinds to keep: all (everything but upcoming), vod (live streams and their replays), normal (plain uploads). Default all.

shortsFilter.description: Which videos to keep: all, normal (no Shorts) or shorts (only Shorts). Default all.

contentMode.description: Whether the channel contributes its uploads or its playlists. Default videos.

followed.description: Added in subtube rather than subscribed to on YouTube; listed while true. Default false.

topics.description: YouTube video category ids (strings, e.g. "10" for Music; the table is in shared/fixtures/feed-chips.json). With any listed, only the channel's videos in a listed category are kept; empty or absent keeps every category. Default [].

groups.description: Names of the groups the channel is in (shared/fixtures/groups.json). A group is its name: it exists while a listed channel's filter names it, and two names are one group only when identical. A name has no white space at either end and 1 to 24 code points. Empty or absent means the channel is in no group. Default [].
